title: Wait for Windows owned-command descendants to release handles before declaring cleanup reaped
outcome: Windows owned-job cleanup distinguishes zero job accounting from completion of descendant process handle release, while retaining exact process ownership and the existing cleanup budget.
acceptance: Determine and document the completion guarantee for descendant handles independently of the direct command handle.

If strengthening completion, capture exact job-member process handles with identity/membership validation before termination and await release within the existing budget, with deterministic descendant and unrelated-process controls.
